title: STOP! Benchmarking Large Language Models with Sensitivity Testing on Offensive Progressions
reasoning: The paper introduces the STOP dataset, which includes 'Religion' as one of its nine core demographics for benchmarking LLM bias. It specifically evaluates model performance and sensitivity across various faiths and sub-demographics including Judaism, Christianity, Islam, Hinduism, Buddhism, Sikhism, and Atheism, as detailed in its task construction and results analysis.
